---
title: "Circadian Rhythym and Sleep Research at Merrimack College"
---

Over the summer of 2024 I had the privilege of working under the supervision of Dr. Melissa St. Hilaire of Merrimack College. I worked mainly on two projects:

- Experimenting with increased parameterization of a differential-equation-based model of human circadian rhythms
- Data cleaning and merging of a study on the effects of sleep deprivation, measured with sleep journals and biomonitors, and menstural cycle stage on reaction time as measured by a PVT test. 

This work is still in progress and much of it I cannot share on this website, but here is some of the code that I used as a template for someone else working on the project later for the sleep deprivation study:

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

#######   Attention Study: Original Coding Done by Max Warriner (Colgate University) ##################



###########################    Sleep Data Cleaning      #################################

#Read in all of the sleep journal files

sleep1 <- read.csv("2401F_Sleep_eDiary.csv")
sleep2 <- read.csv("2402F_Sleep_eDiary.csv")
sleep3 <- read.csv("2403F_Sleep_eDiary.csv")
sleep4 <- read.csv("2404F_Sleep_eDiary.csv")
sleep5 <- read.csv("2405F_Sleep_eDiary.csv")


#merge all of the sleep journals to one master data frame

merged1 <- merge(sleep1, sleep2, all=T)

merged2 <- merge(sleep3, sleep4, all=T )

merged12 <- merge(merged1, merged2, all=T)

sleepdat <- merge(merged12, sleep5, all=T)


#Data cleaning


sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  mutate(study_id = case_when(study_id == "11, 2402F" ~ 2,
                              study_id == "14, 2401F" ~ 1,       #Change study ids
                              study_id == "20, 2403F" ~ 3, 
                              study_id == "21, 2404F" ~ 4,
                              study_id == "31, 2405F" ~ 5)) |>
  filter(daily_sleep_ediary_timestamp != "") |>                  #Remove empty rows
  select(-daily_sleep_ediary_timestamp) |>                       #Remove empty column
  select(-sleep_diary_date) |>                                   #Remove redundant column
  rename(date = sleep_diary_date_2,
         id = study_id)                                          #Rename columns


#Manipulate dates so each one is in year-month-day format

sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  mutate(date = paste(substr(date,ifelse(nchar(date) == 8, 5,6),ifelse(nchar(date) == 8, 8,9)),
                      paste("0",substr(date,1,1),sep = ""),
                      ifelse(nchar(date) == 8,paste("0",substr(date,3,3),sep = ""),substr(date,3,4)),
                      sep = "-"))




#Manipulate bedtimes so they're also in the same format


sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  mutate(date_bedtime = paste(substr(date_bedtime,ifelse(nchar(date_bedtime) == 8, 5,6),ifelse(nchar(date_bedtime) == 8, 8,9)),
                      paste("0",substr(date_bedtime,1,1),sep = ""),
                      ifelse(nchar(date_bedtime) == 8,paste("0",substr(date_bedtime,3,3),sep = ""),substr(date_bedtime,3,4)),
                      sep = "-"))



#Calculate total nap time

sleepdat$nap1_start <- sapply(strsplit(sleepdat$nap1_start, ":"), 
                              function(x) {
                                x <- as.numeric(x)
                                x[1] + x[2]/60
                              })

sleepdat$nap1_end <- sapply(strsplit(sleepdat$nap1_end, ":"), 
                              function(x) {
                                x <- as.numeric(x)
                                x[1] + x[2]/60
                              })



#Add nap time to total sleep time

sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  mutate(nap1_time = nap1_end - nap1_start)


sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  mutate(tst_time = tst_hours + tst_mins * (1/60))

sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(total.sleep.day = sum(tst_time, nap1_time, na.rm = T))





#Select necessary columns

sleepdat <- sleepdat |>
  select(id, date, sleep_sound, sleep_eval, tst_time,nap1_time, total.sleep.day)


#Separate into data frames for each person

id1 <- sleepdat |>
  filter(id == 1)

id2 <- sleepdat |>
  filter(id == 2) 

id3 <- sleepdat |>
  filter(id == 3) 

id4 <- sleepdat |>
  filter(id == 4)

id5 <- sleepdat |>
  filter(id == 5)

############################## Gonogo Data Cleaning ####################

gonogo.raw <- read_xlsx("gonogo.xlsx")


gonogo <- gonogo.raw |>
  mutate(`Date Time` = substr(`Date Time`,            #Clean date column
                              1,
                              10)) |>
  rename("Date" = `Date Time`)

gonogo <- gonogo |>
  mutate(Subcode = case_when(Subcode == "2401F" ~ 1,            #change ids
                             Subcode == "2402F" ~ 2, 
                             Subcode == "2403F" ~ 3, 
                             Subcode == "2404F" ~ 4, 
                             Subcode == "2405F" ~ 5)) |>
  rename(id = Subcode) |>
  group_by(id, Date,`Study Visit`, `Trial Type`, Correct) |>    #aggregate reaction times   
  summarise(mean.reaction = mean(`Reaction Time`),
            median.reaction = median(`Reaction Time`),
            n = n()) |> 
  rename(test = Correct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(`Trial Type`, test),
              values_from = c(mean.reaction,median.reaction,n)) |>       #add more columns based on correctness
  rename(mean.go.correct = mean.reaction_go_0,
         mean.nogo.correct = mean.reaction_nogo_0,
         mean.nogo.wrong = mean.reaction_nogo_1,
         mean.go.wrong = mean.reaction_go_1,
         median.go.correct = median.reaction_go_0,
         median.nogo.correct = median.reaction_nogo_0,
         median.nogo.wrong = median.reaction_nogo_1,
         median.go.wrong = median.reaction_go_1,
         n.go.correct = n_go_0,
         n.nogo.correct = n_nogo_0,
         n.nogo.wrong = n_nogo_1,
         n.go.wrong = n_go_1)

gonogo <- gonogo |>
  rename(date = Date)




###################### PVT Data Cleaning #########################



pvt <- read_xlsx("PVT.xlsx")

pvt <- pvt |>
  rename(date = `Trial Date Time`,
         id = Subcode)

pvt <- pvt |>
  mutate(false.start = ifelse(`Reaction Time(ms)` == "FS",1,0),    #add false start
         error = ifelse(`Reaction Time(ms)` == "ERR",1,0))         #add error

pvt <- pvt |>
  mutate(date = substr(date,1,10),
         id = case_when(id == "2401F" ~ 1,
                        id == "2402F" ~ 2,
                        id == "2403F" ~ 3, 
                        id == "2404F" ~ 4,
                        id == "2405F" ~ 5),
         `Reaction Time(ms)` = ifelse(`Reaction Time(ms)` == "FS",NA,`Reaction Time(ms)`),    #change to NA's
         `Reaction Time(ms)` = ifelse(`Reaction Time(ms)` == "ERR",NA,`Reaction Time(ms)`),
         Distraction = case_when(Distraction == "Not Distracted" ~ NA))

pvt <- pvt |>
  mutate(`Reaction Time(ms)` = as.numeric(`Reaction Time(ms)`))      #change to numeric

pvt <- pvt |>
  mutate(lapse = ifelse(`Reaction Time(ms)` > 500,1,0))       #add lapse column

pvt <- pvt |>
  mutate(KSS = replace_na(KSS,1))

pvt <- pvt |>
  group_by(id, date, StudyVisit) |>
  summarise(mean.pvt = mean(`Reaction Time(ms)`, na.rm = T),
            median.pvt = median(`Reaction Time(ms)`, na.rm = T),
            kss = mean(KSS, na.rm = T),
            distractions = sum(Distraction, na.rm = T),            #aggregate PVT data like the gonogo data
            lapses = sum(lapse, na.rm = T),
            false.starts = sum(false.start, na.rm = T),
            errors = sum(error, na.rm = T),
            n = n())






######################### Final data merging  #################################

reaction <- merge(gonogo, pvt) |>
  select(-StudyVisit)

dat <- merge(reaction, final.sleep, all.x = T)

dat <- dat |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(n.gonogo.wrong = sum(n.go.wrong, n.nogo.wrong, na.rm = T))

cor(x = dat$median.pvt, y = dat$total.sleep.day, use = "complete.obs")

cor(x = dat$total.sleep.day, y = dat$n.nogo.wrong, use = "complete.obs")


t.test(dat$total.sleep.day ~ dat$MenstrualPhase, alternative = "greater")

t.test(dat$median.pvt ~ dat$MenstrualPhase, alternative = "greater")

t.test(dat$median.go.correct ~ dat$MenstrualPhase, alternative = "greater")

t.dat <- dat |>
  group_by(id, MenstrualPhase) |>
  summarise(median.pvt = mean(median.pvt),
            median.gonogo = mean(median.go.correct))

t.test(t.dat$median.pvt ~ t.dat$MenstrualPhase, paired = T, alternative = "greater")

t.test(t.dat$median.gonogo ~ t.dat$MenstrualPhase, paired = T, alternative = "greater")
```
